description: ECHO: Search EPA civil and criminal enforcement cases by state, ZIP code, regulatory program, case type, or filing-date range. Returns case identifier, case type and status, lead agency (EPA or state), primary law and section, enforcement outcome, federal and state penalties, cost recovery, compliance action and SEP costs, and filing, settlement, and closing dates. Case rows name no facility: pass a civil caseId to epa_echo_get_case for the facilities, defendants, and settlements behind it. Designed for area-level violation discovery — for a single known facility's enforcement history use epa_echo_get_facility instead. At least one of state or zip_code is required. Page past limit with offset and nextOffset.

case_type.description: Filter by case type: civil (regulatory violations), criminal (willful violations), or all. A filing-date range covers civil cases only: with a date, all returns civil cases and criminal is rejected.

date_filed_end.description: Latest filing date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Civil cases only. Omit, or pass "", for no upper bound.

date_filed_start.description: Earliest filing date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Civil cases only. Omit, or pass "", for no lower bound.

limit.description: Maximum number of cases to return in one call (1–100, default 50). A larger value, up to 5,000, returns 100 with a notice. Page past it with offset and nextOffset.

offset.description: Number of cases to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's nextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

program.description: Filter by regulatory program: CAA=Clean Air Act, CWA=Clean Water Act, RCRA=hazardous waste, SDWA=drinking water, CERCLA=Superfund, EPCRA=emergency planning and community right-to-know (the statute behind TRI), FIFRA=pesticides, TSCA=toxic substances. Matches any law a case cites, so a returned case's programsViolated (its primary law) can differ.

state.description: 2-letter state or territory code where the case is located (e.g. "TX", "PR"), case-insensitive. A case spanning several states matches each of them. ECHO also files some cases under codes outside the USPS set; any 2-character code is searched as written.

zip_code.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the case's facility location; a ZIP+4 such as "98108-1234" searches its first five digits

name: epa_echo_search_violations

cases.description: One page of matching enforcement cases, in ECHO's order: limit cases from offset

items.description: EPA enforcement case record with case number, status, law, and outcome

caseId.description: Case number (e.g. "03-2014-7010"; criminal cases read "CR_1270") — pass a civil one to epa_echo_get_case

caseStatus.description: Civil case status, e.g. "Closed", "Final Order Issued", "Final Order Entered", "Complaint Filed". Absent on criminal cases.

caseType.description: Case category: "Judicial" or "Administrative - Formal" for civil cases, "Criminal" for every criminal case

closedDate.description: Date the case was closed (MM/DD/YYYY). Absent while it is open.

complianceActionCostInDollars.description: Estimated cost of the injunctive relief and other actions required to return to compliance, in dollars. Absent on criminal cases.

costRecoveryInDollars.description: Response costs the parties agreed or were ordered to repay, in dollars — the outcome of a CERCLA cost-recovery case. Absent on criminal cases.

enforcementOutcome.description: How the case was resolved, e.g. "Final Order With Penalty", "Final Order No Penalty". Absent when ECHO records none, and on criminal cases.

filedDate.description: Date the enforcement case was filed (MM/DD/YYYY) — the date the filing-date range bounds

penaltyAssessedInDollars.description: Federal penalty assessed in dollars (parsed from ECHO dollar string)

primarySection.description: Section of the primary law (e.g. "107A"); a criminal case cites the U.S. Code (e.g. "33 U.S.C. 1908(a)")

stateLocalPenaltyInDollars.description: State or local penalty assessed in dollars. Absent on criminal cases.

supplementalProjectCostInDollars.description: Cost of Supplemental Environmental Projects the parties agreed to, in dollars. Absent on criminal cases.

effectiveQuery.description: The search as the server sent it upstream, in this tool's input names: normalized values, how each text filter matched ("=" exact, "contains", "begins with", "has words"), and defaults that change what comes back. Terms are separated by "; ".

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_geographic_filter`: Neither state nor zip_code was provided. `invalid_date`: date_filed_start or date_filed_end is not a real calendar date, such as 2024-02-30. `date_range_inverted`: date_filed_start is later than date_filed_end. `criminal_date_filter`: case_type "criminal" was combined with a filing-date bound, which ECHO records for civil cases only. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitNotice.description: Present when limit was above the cap and the call returned the cap instead.

message.description: Recovery hint when the page is empty: no case matched, or offset is past the last match. Absent when cases are returned.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page: present exactly when more records follow, absent on the last page. Pass it as offset to continue.

notice.description: Present when a filing-date range with case_type "all" left criminal cases out of the results, or when more cases follow (names the offset that continues the list).

totalCount.description: Cases matched before limit and offset were applied

title: Search EPA Enforcement Cases
